lines: You walk into the room and know just what you're worth,
with a calm and steady voice, from head to toe alert.
You speak with clarity and don't hold back your thoughts,
and everyone just nods along, impressed with how you're fought.
You carry yourself well and say just what you mean,

but when it falls apart, you act like that was just the night.
You lead the team with even pace, no panic, no regret,

But sometimes folks feel stifled out, with little voice or clue,
as if you just assume the role and think it fits with you.
You walk into a room like fate has paved the path ahead,
with shoes that shine and posture right and not one hair misplaced instead.
You make a friend with just a grin and shake their hand twice fast,
but after time, it feels like form, more than a heartfelt last.
You never fear the unknown world, you take it in with stride,
you meet new faces, new roles, with open eyes and wide.
You don't back down from talk or task, you've got the guts to try,
but few find charm in bravado when it lacks a second eye.
You stand up tall in meetings, no one else takes the lead,
you know the plan, you speak the goals, your word becomes the creed.
You draw the map, you call the shots, you're there before the rest,
but leave behind the feeling of 'again, I see the best.'
You act with purpose, sharp and clear, you've got your ways refined,
you're not the sort to take a loss, you stand up past the blind.
You share your goals with full belief, with hope and not with gloom,
but sometimes people just roll eyes when you make your move.

your voice is always raised, your stance forever pure.

which means you often miss the twist that comes next silly.

but leave behind no lesson or surprise in trace.

You smile with purpose in the light of day,
but smile the same in times of wrong or gray.
You speak in full, well-ordered sentences,

but rarely offer help when someone's sway'd.
You plan ahead for most things that you do,
with goals set firm and paths you've carved out neat.
You follow steps just as you laid them down,
and never look for meaning in the beat.
You give your word and mean it in return,

But sometimes trust can feel too fixed and cold,

You finish what you start with steady hands,

Yet no one really knows the thoughts that drive,
or if the task was worth the effort cracked.
You never doubt the path you're walking down,
though others wonder where the road might lead.
It seems that certainty's a mask you wear,
not something true or fully understood.
You claim your strengths and stand by them alone,
no need for change or a new outlook evermore.
This kind of confidence might scare some folks,
who see a wall where others saw a door.
